svg.title: watsonx Orchestrate in three of IBM’s facts
svg.desc: 30 days free trial from IBM. IBM’s Trial plan: agent building, the chat interface, the tools catalog, the control plane, and evaluation and observability. On premises or fully managed on IBM Cloud or AWS. IBM says it runs as a fully managed multi-cloud service on IBM Cloud or AWS, or in your own on-premises environment. Per user and per message. IBM’s plans set limits on monthly active users and on messages per month.
